newsitem.title: JAPAN: Money policy should not overemphasise forex -- BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Money policy should not overemphasise forex -- BOJ.

text.p: Monetary policy should not overly emphasise the stability of foreign exchange rates or correcting imbalances in Japan's current account, Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita told a parliamentary committee on Friday.
Matsushita said the easy monetary policy the BOJ carried out in the late 1980s was one factor that brought about the so-called "bubble economy" of inflated asset prices.

He added that, at the time, such a policy was taken as part of an overall economic policy that put priority on reducing Japan's large current account surplus and correcting the appreciation of the yen.
"From past experience, we should be vigilant not to overly emphasise in our monetary policy the stability of foreign exchange rates or correcting overseas imbalances," he said.
